verdict.rationale: Heap's homepage names a built-in AI chat feature, Sense Chat, that lets users "go straight to insights", so the product does have its own in-product assistant. The only evidence is a single marketing line, and it describes help getting insights rather than delegating tasks. missing for 10: documentation of what tasks Sense Chat can perform on the user's behalf (e.g., building charts or reports, running analyses), any agentic or multi-step task execution, usage docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Sense Chat makes it easy for anyone to get started with analytics, no matter their experience. Skip the learning curve and lengthy onboarding—and go straight to insights.
